title: PCBFormer: Understanding 3D Structure of RealWorld PCB Traces for S-Parameter Prediction
problem: S-parameter extraction for PCB traces via electromagnetic simulation is computationally expensive and becomes a bottleneck with iterative design changes in component placement.
motivation: Efficient S-parameter prediction enables faster signal integrity analysis and PCB design iteration.
method: PCBFormer is a deep learning framework capturing electromagnetic interactions across multiple layers in 3D PCB structures. The model accounts for each layer's properties and multiple traces' coupling effects to predict S-parameters across frequency ranges from DC to 1 GHz.
key_novelty: Deep learning framework capturing multi-layer 3D PCB trace interactions for rapid S-parameter prediction.
contributions: Multi-layer 3D PCB structure modeling in deep learning
Capture of electromagnetic coupling across traces and layers
0.86 R² score across 210 S-parameters for realistic PCBs
High accuracy replacement for electromagnetic simulation
limitations: Accuracy depends on training data quality and may not generalize to PCBs with significantly different layer configurations or materials.
